dialogues.jp:
目を覚ますと、爽やかな陽の光が窓から部屋の
中に差し込んでいた。
dialogues.en:
I opened my eyes, greeted by the bright rays of the sun
streaming into my room.
dialogues.text:
I opened my eyes, greeted by the bright rays of the sun
streaming into my room.

dialogues.jp: 「……今日もいい天気だ」
dialogues.en: "...Today looks like a good day."
dialogues.text: "...Today looks like a good day."

dialogues.jp:
最近の俺は、目覚し時計が無くても起きれるよ
うになっている。
dialogues.en: Recently, I haven't needed to use an alarm clock to wake up.
dialogues.text: Recently, I haven't needed to use an alarm clock to wake up.

dialogues.jp:
窓外を通り過ぎていく小鳥の｛さえず／囀｝りすらも、耳に
する余裕があるくらいだ。
dialogues.en:
The sound of the birds chirping outside my window is usually
enough.
dialogues.text:
The sound of the birds chirping outside my window is usually
enough.

dialogues.jp:
ま、神社の掃除に付き合うために早起きするこ
とが多くなったからな。
dialogues.en:
And something in me tells me when to wake up, and why, as
well...
dialogues.text:
And something in me tells me when to wake up, and why, as
well...

dialogues.jp:
自分の中で『起きたい』という気持ちが強くな
るだけで、こうも違うものかな……。
dialogues.en:
Long gone are the days Nemu would wake me up by hook, or far
more often, by crook.
dialogues.text:
Long gone are the days Nemu would wake me up by hook, or far
more often, by crook.

dialogues.jp: 音夢に叩き起こされていた頃とは、大違いだ。
dialogues.en: "...Now then."
dialogues.text: "...Now then."

dialogues.jp: 「……よっと」
dialogues.en: I lifted my body up into a sitting position.
dialogues.text: I lifted my body up into a sitting position.

dialogues.jp: ベッドから身を起こす。
dialogues.en: There's still some time before the appointed time.
dialogues.text: There's still some time before the appointed time.

dialogues.jp: まだ、約束の時間まで余裕があった。
dialogues.en: Good job, me... no way I can been late today.
dialogues.text: Good job, me... no way I can been late today.

dialogues.jp:
上出来、上出来。今日は遅刻なんか、できない
からな。
dialogues.en:
Hoisting myself out of bed, I began to change out of my
pajamas.
dialogues.text:
Hoisting myself out of bed, I began to change out of my
pajamas.

dialogues.jp: 俺はベッドから降り、服を着替え始めた。

dialogues.en: Today's date is going to be more special than usual.
dialogues.text: Today's date is going to be more special than usual.

dialogues.jp:
今日は環が快復してから、初めてのデートとい
うことになる。
dialogues.en: The words Tamaki said yesterday...
dialogues.text: The words Tamaki said yesterday...

dialogues.jp:
そして、今日のデートが特別なものになること
を俺は知っていた。
dialogues.en: "I want you to see my Miko dance."
dialogues.text: "I want you to see my Miko dance."

dialogues.jp: 環が昨日、電話でそっと教えてくれた……。
dialogues.en: Her voice was oddly vibrant when she said that.
dialogues.text: Her voice was oddly vibrant when she said that.

dialogues.jp: 『私の巫女の舞を、見てください』
dialogues.en:
I would've thought given all that she went through, she
would've been more conflicted on those issues.
dialogues.text:
I would've thought given all that she went through, she
would've been more conflicted on those issues.

dialogues.jp: 環の声は、意外にさっぱりしていた。
dialogues.en:
But from the way she talked about it, she seemed to be
completely at ease.
dialogues.text:
But from the way she talked about it, she seemed to be
completely at ease.

dialogues.jp:
その言葉を口にするには、俺が思う以上に複雑
な葛藤があったと思う。
dialogues.en:
She was truly speaking like someone that's found her
calling.
dialogues.text:
She was truly speaking like someone that's found her
calling.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、聞いた声からは、そんなことは少しも
感じられなかった。
dialogues.en:
Her resolve and commitment she showed then, was not lost on
me.
dialogues.text:
Her resolve and commitment she showed then, was not lost on
me.

dialogues.jp: 迷いから解放されたような、晴れやかな口調。
dialogues.en: Nor her feelings as a Miko, nor her feelings as a girl.
dialogues.text: Nor her feelings as a Miko, nor her feelings as a girl.

dialogues.jp:
そんな声を環が取り戻してくれただけで、俺は
全てを受け入れられる気持ちになる。
dialogues.en:
I may not have been too fascinated with Miko originally,
but,
dialogues.text:
I may not have been too fascinated with Miko originally,
but,

dialogues.jp:
巫女としての自分を受け入れる。そして、また
女の子としての自分も受け入れる。
dialogues.en: Thanks to Tamaki, my interest in them is at it's peak.
dialogues.text: Thanks to Tamaki, my interest in them is at it's peak.

dialogues.jp:
巫女として、俺と恋愛をすることは本来間違っ
ているのかもしれないけれど、
dialogues.en: And no matter what happens, Tamaki is Tamaki.
dialogues.text: And no matter what happens, Tamaki is Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
環は恋愛を受け入れた上で、自分は巫女のまま
でいようというのだった。
dialogues.en:
She wants me to see her dance... her dance that seperates
her past from her present and future.
dialogues.text:
She wants me to see her dance... her dance that seperates
her past from her present and future.

dialogues.jp:
環は俺に舞を見せると言って、電話をかけてき
た。それは、きっと彼女が新しい自分になるた
めの、ひとつのケジメなのだろう。
dialogues.en: "Off with me, then."
dialogues.text: "Off with me, then."

dialogues.jp: 服を着替え終えた俺は、部屋を出た。
dialogues.en: After finishing changing my clothes, I headed out.
dialogues.text: After finishing changing my clothes, I headed out.

dialogues.jp: 俺は枯れない桜へと歩いていく。
dialogues.en:
And started walking in the direction of the Unwithering
Sakura.
dialogues.text:
And started walking in the direction of the Unwithering
Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
花びらのない桜の木は、それはそれで美しかっ
た。年がら年中咲いているのとは、また違う美
しさ。
dialogues.en:
Even without sakura petals, the tree looked majestic,
different from it's usual bloom.
dialogues.text:
Even without sakura petals, the tree looked majestic,
different from it's usual bloom.

dialogues.jp:
春という季節の中で咲き誇り、散っていく……
普通の桜だ。
dialogues.en:
A spring where the sakura petals bloom, and scatter... a
normal spring.
dialogues.text:
A spring where the sakura petals bloom, and scatter... a
normal spring.

dialogues.jp:
春に咲いて、散る……。そんな当たり前のこと
が今は嬉しい。
dialogues.en:
Blooming in spring, and scattering... even something as
normal as that put a smile on my face.
dialogues.text:
Blooming in spring, and scattering... even something as
normal as that put a smile on my face.

dialogues.jp:
そして彼女は、舞を踊る場所に、その当たり前
に戻った桜の木の下を選んだのだ。
dialogues.en:
And she wanted her dance to take place there... under that
now-normal sakura tree.
dialogues.text:
And she wanted her dance to take place there... under that
now-normal sakura tree.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 『朝倉様に見て欲しいんです』
dialogues.en: "I want Asakura-sama to see it."
dialogues.text: "I want Asakura-sama to see it."

dialogues.jp: 環は俺にそう言った。
dialogues.en: She had said that to me after.
dialogues.text: She had said that to me after.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
『この舞は……私にとって、とてもとても大切
　な意味を持つ舞ですから……』
dialogues.en: "The dance... has a very, very important meaning to it..."
dialogues.text: "The dance... has a very, very important meaning to it..."

dialogues.jp: とも、言った。
dialogues.en: She ended with that mystery.
dialogues.text: She ended with that mystery.

dialogues.jp: 一体、何なんだろう？
dialogues.en: What did she mean, I wonder?
dialogues.text: What did she mean, I wonder?

dialogues.jp:
そんな神聖な儀式に、俺なんかが呼ばれちゃっ
て大丈夫なのだろうか？
dialogues.en: Was it really alright to let me see such a holy ritual?
dialogues.text: Was it really alright to let me see such a holy ritual?

dialogues.jp:
そう思う一方で、なんとなく分かる気もする。
漠然とした感じではあるが……。
dialogues.en:
Yet somehow, I could feel that she wanted to tell me
something...
dialogues.text:
Yet somehow, I could feel that she wanted to tell me
something...

dialogues.jp:
今日は二人にとって、大切な日になるだろうと
いうことも含めて……。
dialogues.en: Wanting to make this a special day for both of us...
dialogues.text: Wanting to make this a special day for both of us...

dialogues.jp: 桜の前には、もう環が先に待っていた。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was waiting right in front of the sakura tree.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was waiting right in front of the sakura tree.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 環は俺が来るのを見て、にっこり微笑む。
dialogues.en: She broke into a smile as she saw me approaching.
dialogues.text: She broke into a smile as she saw me approaching.

dialogues.jp:
俺は歩み寄りながら、環を爪先から頭まで見回
してしまった。
dialogues.en:
As I continued walking towards her, she stood on her
tiptoes, looking around the place.
dialogues.text:
As I continued walking towards her, she stood on her
tiptoes, looking around the place.

dialogues.jp:
もう何度も見ているはずなのに、今日はなんだ
か｛りり／凛々｝しく見えた。
dialogues.en:
No matter how many times I look at her, she always seems to
get more beautiful every day.
dialogues.text:
No matter how many times I look at her, she always seems to
get more beautiful every day.

dialogues.jp:
ピンっと張り詰めたものがあって、その折り目
正しい美しさというか、清潔感を感じる。
dialogues.en:
Especially today, with her getting ready to perform her
dance.
dialogues.text:
Especially today, with her getting ready to perform her
dance.

dialogues.jp: 俺は着く早々、つい見とれてしまっていた。
dialogues.en: As I arrived, I quickly looked around as well.
dialogues.text: As I arrived, I quickly looked around as well.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうかされましたか？」
dialogues.en: "Is something the matter?"
dialogues.text: "Is something the matter?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「遅れてすまん」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, I'm late."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I'm late."

dialogues.jp: つい、条件反射でそう言ってしまう。
dialogues.en: The response came out automatically.
dialogues.text: The response came out automatically.

dialogues.jp: 環はクスリと笑って、
dialogues.en: She giggled and replied,
dialogues.text: She giggled and replied,

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「まだ５分前ですよ」
dialogues.en: "You're still 5 minutes early."
dialogues.text: "You're still 5 minutes early."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうか……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, so I am..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, so I am..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は誤魔化すために頭をかく。
dialogues.en: I pretended to be clueless.
dialogues.text: I pretended to be clueless.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今日はわざわざすみません」
dialogues.en: "I apologize for asking you to come here so suddenly."
dialogues.text: "I apologize for asking you to come here so suddenly."

dialogues.jp:
環が俺に深深と頭を下げる。そんなところは以
前と変わらない。
dialogues.en:
She bowed to me deeply in apology. That part of her still
hasn't changed.
dialogues.text:
She bowed to me deeply in apology. That part of her still
hasn't changed.

dialogues.jp: 「構わないさ。環のお願いだからね」
dialogues.en: "It's no problem, it was what you wanted, after all."
dialogues.text: "It's no problem, it was what you wanted, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「気にしないでくれ」
dialogues.en: "Don't mention it."
dialogues.text: "Don't mention it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Okay..."
dialogues.text: "Okay..."

dialogues.jp: なんとなく緊張してしまう。
dialogues.en: A sudden tension floated between us.
dialogues.text: A sudden tension floated between us.

dialogues.jp:
……緊張じゃないな。もっと神々しいもののよ
うな気がする。
dialogues.en:
...Well, not really tension... like some heavenly being was
watching us from above.
dialogues.text:
...Well, not really tension... like some heavenly being was
watching us from above.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、早速始めましょうか」
dialogues.en: "Well then, I shall begin."
dialogues.text: "Well then, I shall begin."

dialogues.jp: 環は厳かに、俺へと向き直った。
dialogues.en: She gestured towards me.
dialogues.text: She gestured towards me.

dialogues.jp: 観客は俺のほかにはいない。
dialogues.en: There wasn't anyone else by myself.
dialogues.text: There wasn't anyone else by myself.

dialogues.jp: 本当に、本当にプライベートな舞……。
dialogues.en: Quite the private show, this...
dialogues.text: Quite the private show, this...

dialogues.jp:
しかし、まるで環は多くの観客に言い聞かせる
ように話し始める。
dialogues.en:
Despite that, she began speaking as if she was addressing an
audience.
dialogues.text:
Despite that, she began speaking as if she was addressing an
audience.

dialogues.jp: なんとなく、声の雰囲気が変わった。
dialogues.en: The air in her tone was different from usual.
dialogues.text: The air in her tone was different from usual.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「舞は、本来、神様に向けられたものですが、
　今日はちょっと違います」
dialogues.en:
"This dance was originally performed in respect to God, but
it's use today is different."
dialogues.text:
"This dance was originally performed in respect to God, but
it's use today is different."

dialogues.jp:
環の言葉ひとつひとつが、俺の中で重なり合っ
て、重みを帯びていく。
dialogues.en: I hung on each and every word that came out of her mouth.
dialogues.text: I hung on each and every word that came out of her mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「全ての人に……自分を取り巻く全ての人、そ
　の人たちの、これからの未来のために」
dialogues.en: "For... all the people around me, and their futures."
dialogues.text: "For... all the people around me, and their futures."

dialogues.jp: 環が、すーっとゆるやかに手をあげる。
dialogues.en: She lifted her hand up majestically.
dialogues.text: She lifted her hand up majestically.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくしを愛し育ててくれた両親のために」
dialogues.en: "For my parents, who brought me up so lovingly."
dialogues.text: "For my parents, who brought me up so lovingly."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくしを励ましてくれた友人のために」
dialogues.en: "For my friends, who were always there to support me."
dialogues.text: "For my friends, who were always there to support me."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくしを信じてくれた人たちのために」
dialogues.en: "For the people who put never gave up hope in me."
dialogues.text: "For the people who put never gave up hope in me."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そして……」
そこで、環は俺の目を正面から見つめ、
dialogues.en: She turned her gaze straight to me.
dialogues.text: She turned her gaze straight to me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくしの大切な人のために……」
dialogues.en: "For the person most important to me..."
dialogues.text: "For the person most important to me..."

dialogues.jp: その俺を見つめる瞳に、どきりとする。
dialogues.en: Her words and look gave me goosebumps.
dialogues.text: Her words and look gave me goosebumps.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「私は踊りたい……」
dialogues.en: "I shall dance..."
dialogues.text: "I shall dance..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の言葉に聞き惚れていた。
dialogues.en: I listened to her words with a smile.
dialogues.text: I listened to her words with a smile.

dialogues.jp: ヘタに口など出せない、荘厳な空気。
dialogues.en: She wasn't hesitating or joking, but solemn and serious.
dialogues.text: She wasn't hesitating or joking, but solemn and serious.

dialogues.jp: この、心地よい緊張感。
dialogues.en: This was the good type of tension.
dialogues.text: This was the good type of tension.

dialogues.jp: 神に仕えたものの、想いをこめた舞。
dialogues.en: A dance for the Gods, filled with the feelings of humans.
dialogues.text: A dance for the Gods, filled with the feelings of humans.

dialogues.jp: ひとりの女の子の……万感の想いを込めた舞。
dialogues.en: More accurately, the flood of emotions from a single girl.
dialogues.text: More accurately, the flood of emotions from a single girl.

dialogues.jp:
それが厳かなものでなかったら、一体何を厳か
と言うのだろうか？
dialogues.en:
It may not be true to it's origins, but it'd be dignified
all the same.
dialogues.text:
It may not be true to it's origins, but it'd be dignified
all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「では、始めたく思います」
dialogues.en: "If you're ready, I shall begin."
dialogues.text: "If you're ready, I shall begin."

dialogues.jp: 俺はじっと環を見詰め、ただうなずいた。
dialogues.en: I simply looked and nodded.
dialogues.text: I simply looked and nodded.

dialogues.jp: それだけでいい。
dialogues.en: That was all that was worthy.
dialogues.text: That was all that was worthy.

dialogues.jp: 目の前が一瞬、白く変わる。
dialogues.en: In a flash, my the vision in front of me turned white.
dialogues.text: In a flash, my the vision in front of me turned white.

dialogues.jp: 思わず、目を閉じてしまった。
dialogues.en: I unconsciously blinked at the sudden change.
dialogues.text: I unconsciously blinked at the sudden change.

dialogues.jp:
目を開けると、そこには今までの巫女装束では
なく、きらびやかなまるで天女のような巫女服
を着た環がいた。
dialogues.en:
Once my eyes opened again, I was greeted by the dazzling
sight of Tamaki in a Celestial Maiden outfit.
dialogues.text:
Once my eyes opened again, I was greeted by the dazzling
sight of Tamaki in a Celestial Maiden outfit.

dialogues.jp:
いつもの巫女服の下に、こんな綺麗な衣装を着
ていたのか……。
dialogues.en:
Was she always wearing this gorgeous outfit under her Miko
costume?
dialogues.text:
Was she always wearing this gorgeous outfit under her Miko
costume?

dialogues.jp:
俺は、頭がぽうっとするような高揚感に包まれ
る。優しく、温かい、不思議な空気。
dialogues.en:
Adjectives kept popping into my head to describe how it
felt. Warm, gentle, mysterious...
dialogues.text:
Adjectives kept popping into my head to describe how it
felt. Warm, gentle, mysterious...

dialogues.jp: 環の手がゆっくりと上がった。
dialogues.en: Her hand slowly rose into the air.
dialogues.text: Her hand slowly rose into the air.

dialogues.jp: 神楽が鳴り始め、環はゆっくりと舞を始める。
dialogues.en:
As the melodies of ancient Shinto music graced my ears,
Tamaki began her dance.
dialogues.text:
As the melodies of ancient Shinto music graced my ears,
Tamaki began her dance.

dialogues.jp:
時折、桜の花びらと戯れるように、風を起こし
ながら……。
dialogues.en:
Even the sakura petals seemed to get in on the action,
fluttering playfully around Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
Even the sakura petals seemed to get in on the action,
fluttering playfully around Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: そして、風と戯れながら……。
dialogues.en: The wind began to blow as well...
dialogues.text: The wind began to blow as well...

dialogues.jp: ありとあらゆる空気と、ありとあらゆる自然に。
dialogues.en:
Every part of nature seemed to co-ordinate themselves with
Tamaki's performance.
dialogues.text:
Every part of nature seemed to co-ordinate themselves with
Tamaki's performance.

dialogues.jp: 町や道路、自分を取り巻く風景の全てに。
dialogues.en: The roads and town, the scenery.
dialogues.text: The roads and town, the scenery.

dialogues.jp: そして、自分を取り巻くありとあらゆる人々に。
dialogues.en:
Even the people around her who'd made a difference to her
life.
dialogues.text:
Even the people around her who'd made a difference to her
life.

dialogues.jp: 惜しみない愛を込めて……。
dialogues.en: Her dance had her boundless love...
dialogues.text: Her dance had her boundless love...

dialogues.jp: 例えようもない深い感謝を込めて……。
dialogues.en: Her words of thanks...
dialogues.text: Her words of thanks...

dialogues.jp: 積み重ねてきた過去と……。
dialogues.en: All piled up from her past days...
dialogues.text: All piled up from her past days...

dialogues.jp: 積み重ねていく未来に……。
dialogues.en: All in the future to come...
dialogues.text: All in the future to come...

dialogues.jp: 精一杯の感謝と祈りを込めて……。
dialogues.en: A prayer putting in all her gratitude...
dialogues.text: A prayer putting in all her gratitude...

dialogues.jp: 舞は、動きを奏でる。
dialogues.en: Her dance continued like a play.
dialogues.text: Her dance continued like a play.

dialogues.jp: 万感の想いを乗せて、環は舞いつづける。
dialogues.en:
She danced with all her heart, letting her emotions and
feelings take over.
dialogues.text:
She danced with all her heart, letting her emotions and
feelings take over.

dialogues.jp: そうなんだ……。これが環なんだ……。
dialogues.en: That's right... this is Tamaki...
dialogues.text: That's right... this is Tamaki...

dialogues.jp:
不安や恐怖を抱えながら、いろんな人の幸せを
願ってきた巫女……。
dialogues.en:
A Miko, holding such uneasiness and fear, yet steadfastly
praying happiness for so many...
dialogues.text:
A Miko, holding such uneasiness and fear, yet steadfastly
praying happiness for so many...

dialogues.jp:
いろんな人の未来が幸せであることを望んでき
た女の子……。
dialogues.en: A simple girl, wishing for a blessed future for so many...
dialogues.text: A simple girl, wishing for a blessed future for so many...

dialogues.jp: それが環なんだ。
dialogues.en: That's the essence of who Tamaki is.
dialogues.text: That's the essence of who Tamaki is.

dialogues.jp:
本来……人は未来が見えないからこそ、明日の
幸せを神に祈っていた。
dialogues.en:
For us normal people, who can't see the future... we pray to
God for a better tomorrow.
dialogues.text:
For us normal people, who can't see the future... we pray to
God for a better tomorrow.

dialogues.jp: そんな、根本的なことをふと思い出す。
dialogues.en: Even I remember doing such a basic thing, myself.
dialogues.text: Even I remember doing such a basic thing, myself.

dialogues.jp: 人は自分の未来が幸せであることを願う。
dialogues.en: People wish that their future is bright.
dialogues.text: People wish that their future is bright.

dialogues.jp: でも、未来が見えてしまっていた環は違った。
dialogues.en: But for Tamaki, who can see the future, it was different.
dialogues.text: But for Tamaki, who can see the future, it was different.

dialogues.jp:
未来が見えるからこそ、自分ではなく、周りの
人々が幸せであることを願った。
dialogues.en:
Being able to see the future, she wished not for her own
happiness, but for the people around her.
dialogues.text:
Being able to see the future, she wished not for her own
happiness, but for the people around her.

dialogues.jp: でも、今は違う。
dialogues.en: But now, it's different.
dialogues.text: But now, it's different.

dialogues.jp:
他人の未来のためだけではない。自分の未来の
ための幸せを願える女の子になった。
dialogues.en:
Now, it's not only for others... but for her own future, as
the girl she is.
dialogues.text:
Now, it's not only for others... but for her own future, as
the girl she is.

dialogues.jp:
そして、そんな環は……俺と一緒に未来を築い
ていく。
dialogues.en:
And that Tamaki, and I... will build a better future with
our own hands.
dialogues.text:
And that Tamaki, and I... will build a better future with
our own hands.

dialogues.jp: この舞は、神様に向けられたものではない。
dialogues.en: This dance isn't to worship God.
dialogues.text: This dance isn't to worship God.

dialogues.jp:
俺と環……二人の未来のために、環は舞ってく
れているんだ。
dialogues.en: It's a dance, for our future... Tamaki is dancing for that.
dialogues.text: It's a dance, for our future... Tamaki is dancing for that.

dialogues.jp: 二人の未来が幸せであることを……。
dialogues.en: So that our future will be bright...
dialogues.text: So that our future will be bright...

dialogues.jp: それが永遠であることを祈ってくれている。
dialogues.en: And everlasting, and so we pray.
dialogues.text: And everlasting, and so we pray.

dialogues.jp: 神さま、今日だけは、許してくれ。
dialogues.en: God, please forgive us, just for today.
dialogues.text: God, please forgive us, just for today.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 舞いながら、環がにっこりと笑う。
dialogues.en: She smiled broadly at me, in the middle of her dance.
dialogues.text: She smiled broadly at me, in the middle of her dance.

dialogues.jp: わかってるよ、環。
dialogues.en: I know, Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I know, Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 未来は、いつだって俺達の手の中だ……。
dialogues.en: The future is in our hands...
dialogues.text: The future is in our hands...

dialogues.jp:
俺達がそれを捨ててしまわない限り、いつまで
も明るい光を放ちながら、俺達を導いてくれる
だろう。
dialogues.en:
As long as we don't throw that away, we'd surely be guided
to a bright future.
dialogues.text:
As long as we don't throw that away, we'd surely be guided
to a bright future.

dialogues.jp: この先、二人にどんなことがあろうとも。
dialogues.en: From now on, and no matter what happens.
dialogues.text: From now on, and no matter what happens.

dialogues.jp: だから、二人で歩いていこう。
dialogues.en: That's why the two of us will stride on.
dialogues.text: That's why the two of us will stride on.

dialogues.jp: 君が祈り、俺が願う明日に……。
dialogues.en: For the tomorrow you pray for, and I wish for...
dialogues.text: For the tomorrow you pray for, and I wish for...

dialogues.jp: きっと幸せな明日へ。
dialogues.en: It'd surely be a blessed day.
dialogues.text: It'd surely be a blessed day.

dialogues.jp: 二人で歩いていこう……な、環。
dialogues.en: Let's keep going... Tamaki.
dialogues.text: Let's keep going... Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: ◆ＥＤ・最後の舞◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Last Dance?◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Last Dance?◆

dialogues.jp:
久しぶりにデートの約束をした環と俺は、桜公
園で環の舞を見ることになる。
dialogues.en:
As our first date in a long time, I went to see Tamaki dance
at the Sakura Park.
dialogues.text:
As our first date in a long time, I went to see Tamaki dance
at the Sakura Park.

dialogues.jp:
その舞は、全ての人に感謝をささげ、これから
俺達の未来のために舞われたものだ。
dialogues.en:
The dance was one of gratitude to all people, and for
happiness for our future.
dialogues.text:
The dance was one of gratitude to all people, and for
happiness for our future.

dialogues.jp:
これからも、ずっと未来は俺達を導いてくれる
だろう。
dialogues.en: From now on, we'd surely be guided to our future together.
dialogues.text: From now on, we'd surely be guided to our future together.
